decisions.reason: The 5V sensor-rail purpose and default-off boost behavior do not change the battery overcharge or overdischarge protection requirements.
The source decision concerns power delivery to 5V sensors and does not alter battery NTC monitoring, its connector, or its thermal-protection controller.
Identifying sensors as loads on the switchable 5V rail does not necessarily change I2C cable length, bus speed, pull-up resistance, or signal-conditioning behavior.
